weakArgument: AI is super dangerous and will take all our jobs and probably kill everyone so governments should ban everything right now.
strongArgument: Frontier models exceeding 10^25 FLOPs pose demonstrable dual-use risks in automated cyber-warfare and CBRN synthesis. Pre-deployment evaluation standards, modeled after the EU AI Act, establish verifiable safety guardrails without impeding narrow commercial innovation.

weakArgument: Everyone needs money because rich people are greedy and it's not fair that poor people are poor.
